SECTION 313 SMOKE ALARMS 313.1 Smoke alarms. Smoke alarms shall be installed in the following locations: 1. In each sleeping room. 2. Outside each separate sleeping area in the immediate vicinity of the bedrooms. 3. On each additional story of the dwelling, including basements but not including crawl spaces and uninhabitable attics.
